connector.name: MCP by teamwork.com
connector.registryDescription: The Teamwork.com official MCP server helps teams efficiently manage client projects with AI.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.ai.teamwork.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the container image mcp:v1.26.4. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.teamwork. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
